hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway length

hazards.name: Lack of Vertical Separation
hazards.description: While a parking lane exists, there is no vertical or robust physical barrier to protect pedestrians from errant vehicles or prevent sidewalk encroachment.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks visible for pedestrians to safely cross this multi-lane roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles, including a large truck, block visibility between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the travel lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the roadway along the curb

hazards.name: Wide Driveway Conflict
hazards.description: A wide curb cut for a former drive-thru creates a large area where vehicles may cross the pedestrian path without clear priority or demarcation.
hazards.location_in_image: Left-center foreground, leading into the covered structure

hazards.name: Surface Degradation
hazards.description: Cracks and vegetation growth in the sidewalk panels create uneven surfaces and potential trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the sidewalk surface in the foreground

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated space for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near potential crossing points to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and pedestrian crossing signage to designate a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Implement regular cleaning and enforcement to ensure sidewalks remain clear of debris and accessible to all users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearing
interventions.description: Regular removal of debris and enforcement of sidewalk clearance to ensure a continuous, accessible path for all users.

interventions.title: Streetscape Buffering
interventions.description: Installation of planters or street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crossings with high-visibility patterns to define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Traffic calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to manage vehicle speeds and improve safety for all road users.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If the block is long, implement a high-visibility marked mid-block crossing with appropriate signage.

interventions.title: Additional Street Trees
interventions.description: Increase the number of street trees to provide a better physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and bring pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond parked cars.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings to designate safe crossing locations where none currently exist.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a legal and safer crossing point for shoppers.

interventions.title: Street Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Formalize a buffer zone for trash cans and street trees to keep the clear walking path unobstructed.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-scale lighting
interventions.description: Install lighting at a lower height to specifically illuminate the sidewalk and improve safety at night.

interventions.title: Street furniture
interventions.description: Add benches or planters to activate the sidewalk and provide a more welcoming environment.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-Block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and signage to provide a safe, designated crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Implement a high-visibility marked crosswalk, possibly with a pedestrian refuge island, to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Repurpose excess roadway width for bike lanes or wider buffers to narrow travel lanes and naturally slow vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Install street trees or a landscaped buffer between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Parklets
interventions.description: Convert a portion of the on-street parking into a parklet to expand the pedestrian realm and provide seating away from the main walking path.

interventions.title: Enhanced Streetscape
interventions.description: Add more street trees and pedestrian-scale lighting to the left side to improve the buffer and sense of safety.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide a physical buffer and improve the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Streetscape Activation
interventions.description: Encourage murals or green walls on the blank frontage to improve the aesthetic quality and perceived safety of the walkway.

interventions.title: Midblock Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk to provide a designated and safer crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing or Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Repurpose excess roadway width for dedicated bike lanes or wider buffers to naturally slow traffic and provide more protection for non-motorized users.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Demarcation
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the curb cut to the minimum necessary for access and ensure the sidewalk material continues through the driveway to signal pedestrian priority.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone between the curb and the sidewalk to separate pedestrians from traffic and provide a designated space for signage.
